title: Mood status closing accidentally
body: I absolutely love this app but when I’m writing in the mood status section and I accidentally tap on the screen while on my iPad, it goes away and doesn’t auto save. This gets frustrating.
author: Thiccolas Scott

title: Great support!!!
body: After downloading the app, I had several questions and contacted “support” on the app. I was shocked when Andy, the app’s creator, immediately responded. I was planning to wait at least a day or so to hear from anyone (isn’t that the norm for most organizations?). Anyway, Andy was able to answer my questions and point me in the right direction. So helpful!! And so appreciated!!! I would definitely recommend Thruday!
author: fn4m3

title: Almost perfect!
body: I really love this apps design, it has way more functionality than similar apps by being able to look at a full calendar view of future events and the time in between tasks. I love how theres different categories for when things need to be done. I just wish it had apple watch support so I could see my tasks and the count down to them on a complication on the watch face, please consider adding it!!
author: Karenmfff

title: Thoughtfully done
body: Super simple to use. Definitely try it out if you’re living with ADHD
author: RoastMA

title: love the idea but so many bugs
body: i have the premium so i'd appreciate if someone could reach out to me to help me with the bugs i'm experiencing ): it won't let me complete tasks from yesterday i didn't complete on that day and it also won't let me reschedule them for today or tomorrow
author: auggiewoah

title: So close
body:
Immediately asks for a subscription upon opening. Features like setting a routine for every other week are paywalled.
They also do that dark pattern where they let you do paywalled things but don't tell you until you click save.

If this app was $50 I'd buy it. But I'm sick and tired of throwing money into the ether. I'm not doing another subscription I am FED UP
author: Ott62101

title: Better than any other neurodivergent productivity app out there
body: This app as been such a lifesaver for me. It is easily approachable and does a great job of filtering content so I don’t get overwhelmed. It’s just customizable enough to meet my needs without being too much, and has just the right amount of features. I can keep all of my scheduling and tracking in one app without feeling totally underwater every time I open it. Also, the development team is so helpful. Any time I have an issue they are quick to respond and clearly have a genuine interest in helping people. If you run into a problem, just reach out! They are always improving. Highly recommend this app to anyone. Thank you Thruday!
author: marsupialmaybie

title: Game Changer!
body: This is the best app I’ve found to help my daughter complete daily tasks without me verbally reminding her which makes her annoyed with me. Also, the developer has been very helpful when I’ve had questions……words can’t convey my thanks!!!
author: LaureeHead

title: Such potential, but misses the key point for ADHD
body: This app should be a perfect fit for someone with executive function issues— it allows a person to create individual schedules with tasks broken down into steps, it gives the opportunity to create multiple reminders, and it has functionality that allows you to invite another person to support or manage your schedule. Unfortunately where it fails is pretty much on the most important point of reminders and checklists— the reminders pop up silently on your phone, with no audible sound or even a vibration. So unless you’re looking at your phone 24/7, you may as well have no checklist at all. Equally bad— it checks off the reminders automatically after the scheduled time has passed, not only removing the dopamine incentive that comes with checking something off your list, but also leaving people with short term memory issues unclear on whether they actually did or did not do a particular task. That said, this app has enormous potential, and I believe with some minor tweaks it could be the perfect partner for someone with ADHD. Selfishly, I hope the tweaks come sooner rather than later, because as another reviewer said, forgetting the cancel the trial just cost me (and my son, separately) $49 each for a year of something that is currently functionally useless to us both.
author: TeomRachel

title: Good app/ just not for me
body:
I like the free trial to test it out but don’t forget to cancel it on time like I did. It’s pretty easy to set up and use. I like the articles and mood tracker. The schedule works great too. I’m just not able to afford a new subscription due to the fact that I am disabled and social security is not enough to live on so I have to pinch every penny. 
I tried to stay on a schedule but I found that it wasn’t working for me and I started to ignore the reminders. I couldn’t find a way to snooze or mark it uncompleted either. I like to check things off my list to see my progress when I’m done. 
Thanks for letting me try your app and I appreciate what you’re doing to help neurodivergent folks like me. 
I’m just not ready to do without my pencil and sticky notes yet.
author: Gypsygrama

title: Want to like this app
body: I use google calendar for work and an integration would be super helpful. Right now to get use out of this app I would need to reenter all of my calendar appointments and tasks and then add more that are specific to the app.
